# Supabase attribution scenarios. All refs, ids and names are fake.
# projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa and projbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb are two projects in org org-fake.

=== MCP create_project: ref in result gives exact
session s1 start=10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:05 tool=mcp__supabase__create_project
  created supabase.project value=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.mcp.create_project
resource supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa name=waitlist account=org-fake created=10:04
expect supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa exact s1 id_in_result

=== CLI projects create: ref in dashboard URL gives exact
session s1 start=10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:06 tool=Bash
  created supabase.project value=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.projects_create
resource supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa name=waitlist account=org-fake created=10:05
expect supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa exact s1 id_in_result

=== MCP apply_migration with project_id: table named in its container
# apply_migration returns only {"success": true}; the project comes from the input.
session s1 start=10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=mcp__supabase__apply_migration
  created supabase.table value=public.customers container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.mcp.apply_migration
resource supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa name=import-dev account=org-fake created=d-0/08:00
resource supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers name=customers account=org-fake parent=supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa seen=advisor
expect supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa unknown
expect supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers exact s1 name_in_container

=== same table name from two sessions in one project
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=11:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=mcp__supabase__execute_sql
  created supabase.table value=public.customers container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=11:10 tool=mcp__supabase__apply_migration
  created supabase.table value=public.customers container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
resource supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers name=customers seen=advisor
expect supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers unknown

=== same table name from two sessions in different projects
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=11:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=mcp__supabase__apply_migration
  created supabase.table value=public.customers container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=11:10 tool=mcp__supabase__apply_migration
  created supabase.table value=public.customers container=projbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
resource supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers name=customers seen=advisor
resource supabase.table:projbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb/public.customers name=customers seen=advisor
expect supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers exact s1 name_in_container
expect supabase.table:projbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb/public.customers exact s2 name_in_container

=== CLI db push with no ref printed: no container, so no match
# supabase db push prints "Applying migration ..." but never the ref. Without
# --project-ref in the command, the target project is unknown.

  created supabase.table value=public.orders sig=supabase.cli.db_push
resource supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.orders name=orders seen=advisor
expect supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.orders unknown
expect-evidence-only supabase.table:public.orders session=s1

=== unscoped db push in another session makes a named table ambiguous
# s2 pushed a migration creating public.orders to an unknown project; it may
# have been this one, so s1's name match is not enough.

# ---- Proof of creation (docs/decisions/0406-proof-of-creation.md) ----

=== CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on an existing advisor table only references it
# The review's reproduction: the statement succeeds whether or not the table
# existed, and advisor tables carry no created_at to veto with.
session s1 start=10:00

  referenced supabase.table value=public.users container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.db_query
resource supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.users name=public.users seen=advisor
expect supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.users unknown

expect supabase.bucket:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/avatars unknown

=== advisor table Muretto listed before the creating action: first-seen veto

expect supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.users unknown

# ---- Deleted and created again under the same name (docs/decisions/0906-recreated-resources.md) ----

=== function deleted and created again by a later session: the later session
# Seen live: s1 deployed demo-webhook at 15:07, it was deleted, s2 deployed a
# new demo-webhook at 15:18. created_at 15:18 is after s1's action by more than
# the tolerance, so s1 created an earlier function; its claim is dropped.
session s1 start=15:00
session s2 start=15:15
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=15:07 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=15:18 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=15:18
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook exact s2 name_in_container
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s2 created it: a creating call
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s1 created an earlier resource with this name at 2026-10-20T15:07:00Z; the provider says this one was created at 2026-10-20T15:18:00Z, after it
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook toolu_b1

=== recreated by a later session via MCP, provider id in the result
session s1 start=09:00
session s2 start=d1/09:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=09:10 tool=mcp__supabase__deploy_edge_function
  created supabase.function value=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=d1/09:10 tool=mcp__supabase__deploy_edge_function
  created supabase.function value=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=d1/09:09
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook exact s2 id_in_result
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s2 created it
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook toolu_b1

=== recreated, but the two actions are within the tolerance: cannot tell
# s1 at 15:10 is only 8 minutes before created_at 15:18: clock skew could
# explain it, so both claims stand and conflict.
session s1 start=15:00
session s2 start=15:15
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=15:10 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=15:18 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=15:18
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook unknown
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook 2 sessions claim
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook toolu_a1 toolu_b1

=== recreated, the later session only referenced it: nobody proven
# s1's claim is dropped; s2 only invoked the function. Nothing is left.
session s1 start=15:00
session s2 start=15:15
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=15:07 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=15:25 tool=Bash
  referenced supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=15:18
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook unknown
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s1 created an earlier resource with this name
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s2 only read or referenced it
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook toolu_a1

=== recreated outside any session: the earlier creator's claim is dropped
session s1 start=15:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=15:07 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=d1/10:00
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook unknown
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook creator unknown: session s1 created an earlier resource with this name at 2026-10-20T15:07:00Z; the provider says this one was created at 2026-10-21T10:00:00Z, after it
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook toolu_a1

=== one session deploys, the function is deleted, the same session deploys again
# Only the second action can have created this instance; it is the same session.
session s1 start=15:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=15:07 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
action toolu_a2 session=s1 at=15:40 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=15:39
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook exact s1 name_in_container
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s1 created it
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s1 created an earlier resource with this name
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook toolu_a2

=== local clock behind the provider within the tolerance: still exact
# The action is stamped 15:12 by this machine; the provider says 15:18.
session s1 start=15:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=15:12 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=15:18
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook exact s1 name_in_container
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s1 created it

=== recreated, the surviving claim still meets the gone_at veto
# s1's claim is dropped; s2's survives, but a scan saw the function gone after
# s2's action, so it was recreated again outside s2.
session s1 start=15:00
session s2 start=15:15
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=15:07 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=15:18 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=15:18 gone=16:00
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook unknown
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook it disappeared at
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s1 created an earlier resource with this name
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook toolu_a1 toolu_b1

=== recreated, the surviving claim still meets the first-seen veto
# A scan listed the name at 15:08 (s1's function) and saw it gone at 15:20;
# first_seen_at is kept across returns, so s2's 15:30 action stays unknown.
session s1 start=15:00
session s2 start=15:15
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=15:07 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=15:30 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=demo-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook name=demo-webhook created=15:30 first_seen=15:08 gone=15:20
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook unknown
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook Muretto listed it at
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook session s1 created an earlier resource with this name
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/demo-webhook toolu_a1 toolu_b1

=== later session redeploys a function the first session created: never the redeployer
# created_at (epoch ms) is unchanged by a redeploy, so s2's deploy only updated
# it. s1's claim is not dropped (it is not before created_at); the two claims
# conflict and the label stays unknown. s2 never gets exact.
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=d1/09:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:30 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=stripe-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=d1/09:10 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=stripe-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/stripe-webhook name=stripe-webhook created=10:29
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/stripe-webhook unknown
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/stripe-webhook 2 sessions claim
expect-evidence supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/stripe-webhook toolu_a1 toolu_b1

=== redeploy by a later session when the creator was not recorded: unknown
session s2 start=d1/09:00
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=d1/09:10 tool=Bash
  created supabase.function value=stripe-webhook container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa sig=supabase.cli.functions_deploy
resource supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/stripe-webhook name=stripe-webhook created=10:29
expect supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/stripe-webhook unknown
expect-reason supabase.function:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/stripe-webhook before session s2's action

=== kind without created_at: two creating sessions a day apart still conflict
# Advisor tables carry no created_at, so nothing is dropped.
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=d1/10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=mcp__supabase__apply_migration
  created supabase.table value=public.customers container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=d1/10:10 tool=mcp__supabase__apply_migration
  created supabase.table value=public.customers container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
resource supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers name=customers seen=advisor
expect supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers unknown
expect-reason supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.customers 2 sessions claim

=== project without created_at: two creating sessions a day apart still conflict
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=d1/10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created supabase.project value=staging container=org-fake
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=d1/10:10 tool=Bash
  created supabase.project value=staging container=org-fake
resource supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa name=staging account=org-fake
expect supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa unknown
expect-reason supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa 2 sessions claim
